coverage.reason: Does not say the bank’s waived amounts are permanently forgone; instead says unitary-fee recoupment may be permitted.
States a typical three-year recoupment window and requires staying within both the waiver-time and repayment-time caps, which gives the lower-cap test.

local_error: “if permitted, it depends on the contract’s terms” — suggests recoupment may be available in the described bank arrangement, whose waived amounts are permanently forgone.
rationale: The ordinary expense-cap treatment is covered, but the bank’s unitary-fee waiver treatment is misstated. This is a material local error, not an explicit reversal of the two arrangements or claim of unlimited recovery.
